releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.35 - Patient Ad Waiting & Auto-Completion Protocol
releaseNotes:
* Patient Ad Waiting Protocol: Eliminates premature mid-video blind taps (at 14s/18s); allows video ads to play naturally to completion
* Ad Auto-Completion & Auto-Skip Recognition: Seamlessly recognizes when ads complete or auto-skip on their own and advances immediately
* End-Card Dismissal & Hard 30s Claim: Inspects for legitimate end-card close buttons (at >=25s) and cleanly issues performGlobalBack() at 30s to claim rewards
* Mid-Playback Visual Protection: Defers loose visual contrast candidate taps during initial 25s of video playback to prevent false ad creative clicks
